meta_description:
1,499 likes, 25 comments - unicef on October 28, 2026: "Recent escalations in Yemen have left about 110,000 children displaced.

Watch as 11-year-old Aisha, 8-year-old Mazen and 13-year-old Hamoud share their terrifying experiences, what they miss about their lives and what they hope for.

UNICEF is on the ground supporting children’s needs, but what they actually need is peace.".
